entities.name: Biolimus-eluting stent
observations: Biodegradable-polymer biolimus-eluting stent reduced the 1-year composite of cardiac death, target-vessel MI, or ischemia-driven target-lesion revascularization versus bare-metal stent in COMFORTABLE AMI (4.3% vs 8.7%; HR 0.49, 95% CI 0.31–0.78; PMID:23078828).
This comparison establishes benefit over bare-metal stents, not superiority over contemporary drug-eluting stents.

source_tools.relevance: COMFORTABLE AMI randomized trial evidence; primary literature search was attempted but returned no visible results

entities.name: PMID:23078828
observations: COMFORTABLE AMI randomized patients with acute MI to biodegradable-polymer biolimus-eluting stents or bare-metal stents; at 1 year the primary composite was 4.3% versus 8.7% (HR 0.49, 95% CI 0.31–0.78).
